findings.title: Form control lacks a detectable accessible name
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Use an associated visible <label>, or an appropriate accessible name where necessary.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 4, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > input:nth-of-type(2); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Button lacks a detectable accessible name
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Add visible button text or an appropriate accessible name.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 5, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > button:nth-of-type(1); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Image is missing alt attribute
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Provide an appropriate alt text, or alt="" for genuinely decorative imagery.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 6, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > img:nth-of-type(1); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Invalid form control lacks a detectable error association
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.detail: aria-invalid is true; no programmatic error reference detected in source.
findings.remediation: Associate clear error text using aria-describedby or aria-errormessage and verify the message is announced.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 4, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > input:nth-of-type(2); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Clickable nonsemantic element needs keyboard review
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Use a native button or link; manually verify keyboard activation and focus.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 6, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

task.name: Create a test account on a safe local signup fixture
steps: Open the signup page in a local test browser
Using only Tab and Shift+Tab, locate and identify each field
Use synthetic name and email values; do not submit real data
Check whether the error is identified and can be corrected
Check focus visibility, order and escape from any overlay
Repeat with a named screen reader and record what is announced
task.environment: Local test page; browser, OS and assistive technology to be recorded by reviewer
task.dataPolicy: Use synthetic test data only; never submit production forms.

checks.title: Keyboard-only journey
checks.instructions: Use Tab and Shift+Tab to reach all essential controls; note focus order and unexpected changes.

checks.title: No keyboard trap
checks.instructions: Move into and out of dialogs, menus and widgets using only keyboard; document any trapped focus.

checks.title: Focus visibility
checks.instructions: At each step, visually locate focus and check it is not fully hidden by sticky UI.

checks.title: Control activation
checks.instructions: Activate controls using Enter/Space where appropriate; do not submit real data.

checks.title: Field names and instructions
checks.instructions: Verify labels and instructions are understood and announced by selected assistive technology.

checks.title: Error identification and recovery
checks.instructions: Use synthetic values on a safe test instance; confirm error identification, correction suggestions and focus.

checks.title: Screen reader journey
checks.instructions: With a named AT/browser/OS combination, verify landmarks, names, state and errors; record observations.

checks.title: Zoom and reflow
checks.instructions: Check 200% zoom, narrow viewport and text resizing without losing essential functionality.

checks.title: Visual contrast
checks.instructions: Measure text and essential UI contrast using an approved tool; include sampled colors and conditions.

checks.title: Comprehension and completion
checks.instructions: Ask a participant or qualified reviewer to assess clarity, predictable navigation, timing and task completion.

manual.disclaimer: AccessSutra reports limited checks and human testing tasks; they do not establish WCAG conformance, certification, legal compliance, or usability for every person.
